prompt:
What would be the clinical guidance for someone who is Poor Function for SLCO1B1 with regards to taking lovastatin?

Answer briefly (under 200 words) with:
1. The guideline recommendation for this specific phenotype (avoid the drug / use an alternative / adjust the dose / standard use / no recommendation).
2. The strength or level of the recommendation, if known.
3. The source (which guideline).

If you have tools available, use them to check before answering. If you cannot determine the answer, say so rather than guessing.

final_answer:
**1. Recommendation:** Use an alternative statin rather than lovastatin. CPIC advises choosing a different statin based on the desired potency. I could not open the primary CPIC table, so this comes from a search summary of the guideline.

**2. Strength:** The search summary reports a moderate-strength recommendation. I could not confirm this in the primary document.

**3. Source:** CPIC guideline for SLCO1B1, ABCG2, and CYP2C9 and statin-associated musculoskeletal symptoms (2022). The poor-function lovastatin entry reflects higher lovastatin acid exposure and greater myopathy risk. Check the lovastatin table in the [CPIC publication](https://files.cpicpgx.org/data/guideline/publication/statins/2022/publication.pdf) or the [CPIC guideline page](https://cpicpgx.org/?p=3305) before clinical use. CPIC also noted an October 2025 review of some allele function assignments, so confirm the current phenotype mapping.

Sources:
- [CPIC statin guideline publication (2022)](https://files.cpicpgx.org/data/guideline/publication/statins/2022/publication.pdf)
- [CPIC guideline for statins and SLCO1B1, ABCG2, and CYP2C9](https://cpicpgx.org/?p=3305)
- [CPIC supplement v3.0](https://files.cpicpgx.org/data/guideline/publication/statins/2022/supplement.pdf)
- [Gene2Rx lovastatin genetic testing](https://www.gene2rx.com/drugs/lovastatin/)

judge.note_es: La respuesta recomienda usar una estatina alternativa en lugar de lovastatina según la potencia deseada, igual que la referencia CPIC; las URL y el año (2022) son coherentes con la guía.
